d: Indonesia’s stock market turmoil has wiped around $65 billion off market value in a single session, as global index provider MSCI raises concerns over transparency, share ownership and suspected market manipulation. Firstpost examines the impact on Indonesian billionaires, the risk of further capital outflows, government reforms and mounting public anger over economic hardship, corruption and toxic haze.
